column3: Seeing my face in the flesh is rendered “met me face to face.”
“Sinful nature” replaces body of the flesh; the circumcision of Christ is rendered “performed by Christ.”
“Sinful nature” replaces flesh; “God” and “Christ” specify the unexpressed subject and Him.
“Debt ascribed to us” specifies handwriting against us.
“The cross” specifies the pronoun in it or Him.
“A Sabbath” is singular where the Greek has Sabbaths.
“False” and “speculation” are supplied; “unspiritual” replaces of his flesh.
Not holding fast is rendered “has lost connection”; God’s growth is expanded as God causing growth.
“Spiritual forces” renders elements; living in the world is rendered “still belonged to the world.”
“False” is supplied with humility; “against the indulgence” renders the relation to the filling of the flesh.
